ai_summary: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Ltd. is experiencing a severe internal governance crisis, with its Board issuing a cease and desist notice to the Promoter Group, asserting they have forfeited voting rights due to a defaulted share pledge and are attempting to convene an "illegal" EGM. This escalating power struggle, coupled with the company's ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process for its Lucknow and Rajasthan projects, highlights significant financial distress and substantial legal and operational risks.
